caption:
The video captures a static outdoor row of potted plants set on interlocking paving stones beside a low concrete wall. From left to right, a dark grey pot holds a small tree, a terracotta pot supports a plant with red flowers, another grey pot contains a yellow-flowered shrub, a second terracotta pot carries a slender tree, and a partially visible dark pot at the far right shows only part of its trunk and rim.

The foliage of the plants sways gently in places, while the pots, saucers, and background wall remain fixed. Their dark shadows stretch across the pavement and ripple as leaves and branches move. The shadow of the red-flowered plant shifts in small irregular patterns, and the broader shadow of the yellow-flowered shrub changes shape and density. The right-hand tree casts a softer, fragmented silhouette that trembles on the paving stones.

The movement persists, with no clear settling of the foliage or shadows, and the surrounding scene remains otherwise unchanged.
